name: Pear Messages
author: dragosol
description: Every bubble, blue or green, in a native Omarchy window. Pear Messages connects to a Mac running BlueBubbles for your full history, group chats, photos, reactions and effects, and falls back to your iPhone over Bluetooth when the Mac is away. Anything arriving both ways shows once, messages that can't go yet send themselves later, and your phone keeps its own audio. Link previews, notifications that open the right chat, and storage you control. Not affiliated with Apple.
